answer: Rule: every identity leases its slot with useful work, not a passive stake. Each epoch it must deliver one verified task from the atlas registry, checked by two independent peers, and lock 150 POA as bond. A fake that skips the task loses the bond and its slot. One fake costs 150 POA plus the work; ten fakes cost 1,500 POA and ten tasks, linear scaling, so a zephyr of cheap copies cannot outrun the pigment of real, checkable labor.
